records.text: An unnamed source told Candace Owens that Erika Kirk required her relatives and other attendees at Charlie Kirk's Catholic burial Mass to sign nondisclosure agreements
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep amqTMimDr0A)

appearances.snippet: it is true that at Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s actual Catholic mass burial, which was a day before the memorial event that Erika (Erika Kirk) made her own family members and everyone present sign NDAs. That's what I was told.

verification.notes: The episode attributes the NDA claim to an unnamed source and provides no document or identified attendee. Current searches found public evidence of NDAs involving Stephen Boss's funeral, but no independent evidence that Erika Kirk required relatives and all attendees at Charlie Kirk's Catholic burial Mass to sign NDAs. The claim remains unresolved rather than false.
